change: board 163: the Matrixify sheet that publishes the 17 CSP exercise-2 pages the storefront answers 404 for, 102 graded questions written and never imported
_note: This gate covers the SHEET and the guards around it. The import itself is a human act against a live store and is not performed here. Run --pre before handover, and again without --pre after the import lands, when the live check can observe the 17 pages it currently cannot.

checks.name: the generator, its refusals, and the CED resolver
a Python reader recomputes the sheet from the raw bytes and the raw probe
checks._why: Different language, different CSV reader, never imports the generator or lib/csp-course-pages.js. It recounts the 404 set out of the JSONL and requires the sheet's handle set to be exactly that set: not a subset, which would silently drop a page somebody counted, and not a superset, which would write a Body HTML over a live page.

checks.name: the house Matrixify preflight, which knows nothing about this page family
an unfinished body must not be publishable
checks.expect_failure: [FAIL] 11.1 a body under 2000 bytes is REFUSED

checks.name: THE ONE THAT SEPARATES A PUBLISH FROM A REWRITE
checks.expect_failure: [FAIL] 11.2 a handle the storefront already serves is REFUSED
checks._why: 18 of these 35 handles already resolve. Every row carries Body HTML, so a row for a live handle overwrites a page nobody meant to touch and Matrixify reports it as a success.

checks.name: unmeasured is not missing, and a 429 is not a 404
checks.expect_failure: [FAIL] 11.3 a handle with no measurement at all is REFUSED
checks._why: Board item #79 records 46 pages of this storefront answering 429 during a crawl. Defaulting an absent measurement to 404 is exactly how a publish becomes an overwrite.

checks.name: a page must not ship with its own links dead
checks.expect_failure: [FAIL] 11.4 a body linking a handle that is not live is REFUSED

checks.name: the CED detector itself, both code shapes
checks.expect_failure: [FAIL] 11.5 a CED Essential Knowledge code in student-visible text is REFUSED (AP CSP shape)

checks.name: the CED detector is actually CONSULTED, proven from the renderer down
checks.expect_failure: [FAIL] 11.9 the generator writes the sheet only because no body carries a CED code
checks._why: No real body carries a CED code, so a detector that works perfectly and is never called would pass every other check. This makes the renderer emit one and requires the generator to stop, which is the only way to prove the refusal is reached rather than merely written.

checks.name: an href inside a script block is not a link, which this repo has already got wrong
checks.expect_failure: [FAIL] 11.6 a /pages/ href inside a script block is NOT counted as a link
checks._why: A dead-link scan here once read href="/pages/'+prev.handle+'" out of a script block and reported 141 dead links that were string concatenation.

checks.name: all 17 return 200 and serve their six graded questions
checks._why: FALSE TODAY, and measured as false rather than assumed: on 2026-09-02 all 17 answered HTTP 404, recorded per handle with a timestamp in smoke/fixtures/csp-exercise-2-live-status.jsonl. A Shopify 404 still returns a full 300 KB themed document, so the status code alone proves nothing after the import either. This asserts the wrapper id only the exercise-2 renderer emits AND counts the six mcq-item blocks, so a 200 serving the 404 template and a page that lost half its questions in the import both fail.
